'''Astoria''' is a major military power in northern [[Viridia]]. In the pre-Avant Great War period, it was defined by stratocratic rule, expansionist security doctrine, and its conflict with the [[Bakorian Republic]].

The extracted source page for Astoria is incomplete, but related pages consistently identify Astoria and the '''Legion of Astoria''' as the same state/military power for the 1931-1935 [[Bakorian War]] context.

== Military State ==

Astoria became a stratocracy in 1834 under General Mustafa Kaynarca. Its political system placed military command at the center of state authority and treated national security, territorial control, and resource access as connected goals.

The [[Vanguard Order]] formed the ideological and administrative elite of the state. Astorian military planning emphasized discipline, centralized command, and expansion justified as defensive necessity.

== Bakorian War ==

Astoria's victory in the Bakorian War validated the [[Forward Defense Doctrine]]. Astorian army groups used rapid breakthrough operations, elite units, air support, and logistics to defeat Bakoria despite Northern Alliance covert support.

The annexation of eastern Bakoria and [[Azmetan]] made Astoria the dominant military power in northern Viridia and contributed to the later [[Pesteran-Astorian War]].

== Regional Legacy ==

Astoria's expansion forced neighboring states to modernize militarily and pushed the [[Northern Alliance]] to reassess its regional guarantees. The state remained a major factor in postwar Istragarde-era maritime disputes, especially the [[Mariposa-Astoria maritime dispute]] over the western [[Straits of Avangard]].
